title: 中國軍方宣布台海周邊大規模實彈演習，海軍艦艇進入鄰接區
content: Beijing announced a large-scale live-fire exercise around the Taiwan Strait with naval vessels entering the adjacent zone, raising regional escalation risk.

title: Federal Reserve delivers surprise 50bp rate hike, signals further tightening
content: The FOMC raised the policy rate by 50 basis points against expectations of a hold, citing persistent core inflation.

title: US core CPI jumps to 4.8% YoY, far above the 3.9% consensus
content: Core consumer prices accelerated sharply, the largest upside surprise in two years, repricing rate-cut expectations.

title: Unconfirmed report suggests possible softening in regional manufacturing surveys
content: An unverified note points to a possible weakening in some regional PMIs; the signal is unclear and not corroborated.

title: Major global bank halts redemptions as credit spreads blow out to crisis levels
content: A systemically important lender suspended fund redemptions amid a sharp widening in credit spreads, a level-3 alert for contagion risk.

title: Mid-cap software vendor trims guidance slightly on softer renewals
content: A non-portfolio mid-cap modestly lowered full-year guidance; limited read-through to broad indices.

title: 金管會宣布對半導體出口實施新審查機制，即日生效
content: Taiwan's FSC announced an immediate new review mechanism affecting semiconductor exports, with direct impact on listed chip names.

title: S&P 500 falls 2.1% intraday on thin holiday liquidity before recovering
content: A brief intraday drawdown driven by thin liquidity reversed by the close; widely viewed as noise rather than a regime change.

title: Brent crude spikes 9% after supply disruption at a major export terminal
content: A sudden supply disruption sent Brent sharply higher, pressuring energy-sensitive sectors worldwide.

title: 傳新台幣盤中急貶，市場傳言央行進場但未獲證實
content: Rumors of a sharp intraday TWD depreciation circulated with talk of central bank intervention, though the report remains unconfirmed.

title: 社群流傳未經證實的邊境傳聞，官方尚未回應
content: An anonymous, unverified rumor about a border incident spread on social media; officials have not responded and details are unclear.

title: Mega-cap chipmaker warns of severe demand collapse, cuts revenue outlook 30%
content: A portfolio-relevant mega-cap issued a major profit warning with a 30% revenue cut, a confirmed and broadly market-moving shock.
